parts.content: Do read-only research for a brainstorming brief about an 'AI Healthcare Contradiction Auditor' that audits FHIR clinical records for consistency. Return a concise report with 3 sections only: 1) regulatory/interoperability context grounded in official public sources, 2) patient-safety/data-quality rationale grounded in official or reputable sources, 3) competitor/adjacent-solution landscape as categories, not speculative vendor claims, if hard evidence is limited. You may use available workspace/web tools. Do not write code. Highlight any open questions that should remain assumptions rather than facts.
